payload.description: Evaluated ChatSession (with agentId) patch for redundancy with existing richer implementation

features: archivedAt timestamp on session and messages

features_comparison.patch_metadata_json: existing: already has metadata via agentId/persona/mode fields
features_comparison.patch_archivedAt: existing: archivedAt on ChatMessage + ChatArchive relation

existing_implementation.superiority: Existing model supports all patch features PLUS persona, mode, three-tier architecture, and per-session archives

payload.decision: SKIP - Patch is subset of existing implementation
rationale: ChatSession.slug already provides unique session identifier (equivalent to sessionKey)
ChatMessage.agentId more granular than session-level (multiple agents per session)
ChatMessage already has persona/mode fields (richer than generic metadata Json)
ChatArchive + GlobalChatArchive provide both per-session AND daily archives
Adding simpler patch would create model duplication without benefit
payload.recommendation: Use existing ChatSession/ChatMessage where patch intended its models
payload.action_taken: none - patch fully superseded by existing three-tier implementation with richer features
